provenance.source_basis: Current thesis Chapter 3, especially Table 3.1 and §§3.3–3.7
provenance.interpretation_guardrail: Process diagram only; completion of individual repairs, verified causes, financial losses and project delays is not asserted

stages.title: Account Transcription
stages.description: Preserve field accounts, source language, observer and dates where known.

stages.title: Topic Grouping
stages.description: Organize concerns into waterproofing and masonry/plaster work.
stages.input: Field accounts and selected building photographs

stages.title: Mechanism Screening
stages.description: List plausible explanations and evidence needed to distinguish them.

stages.title: Technical Comparison
stages.description: Check approved drawings and applicable technical references.

stages.title: Event Verification
stages.description: Require evidence of original work and later corrective action.
stages.output: Verified event or recorded evidence gap

stages.title: Impact Assessment
stages.description: Assess cost or delay only where matched records support it.
stages.output: Supported impact or explicitly unquantified item
